transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Okafor, your Signal Officer. We've got our routine daily communications planning huddle, so let's hear from each of you on your current requirements. Operations, logistics, maintenance, and airfield reps -- what do you need for tomorrow's coordination? Once I have everyone's input, I'll publish the binding communications configuration. The signal shop can configure channels and power settings before 1800 today, so we need to wrap this up with enough time to get everything set.

transcript.text: Everyone, I need to flag a change. The battalion coordination directive confirmed this morning requires the command net to use C2 from 0600 to 1000 tomorrow. I received the directive after the morning briefing, and the communications slide has not yet been updated. We'll need to account for this in today's configuration.
